text: ColorBlock: corner swatch with a black outline. Number: colored score. Both: swatch and number.
Spectrum: red-gray-green-blue-purple-gold (blue/purple skipped when there are few positive grades; the best grade stays gold). Compact: red-gray-green-gold. 0 is always gray; all negatives are red.
Swatch edge in pixels at 16px grid. A 1px black outline is added around it.
Hidden berry quality. The number is the wine-score contribution: mold -1, under/overripe 0, normal +1, small +2.
Normal yeast shows ferment speed; super yeast is faster; illegal yeast makes counterfeit wine; reusable yeast shows infinity.
Base water (98%) is 0. Pure +2, high quality +1, base 0, ghost -1, rust -2, gutterflow -3. Uses real purity.
